claims: Continue intravenous amiodarone infusion and monitor serum electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium) q4h.
Obtain repeat arterial blood gas and lactate measurement in 2 hours to assess metabolic acidosis and tissue perfusion.
Gradually wean norepinephrine infusion as blood pressure stabilizes, targeting MAP ≥65 mmHg.
